scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.metric_basis: FY2026E EBITDA (consensus base + bull-case raw-material and China-demand uplifts)
scenarios.drivers: Raw-material excess-cost growth reverts to 0pp AND China domestic demand partially recovers to +5% YoY; multiple expands to the quality-adjusted/own-history-mean ceiling (7.4x), not the full unadjusted peer median (9.71x). 12-month horizon.

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.multiple_basis: EV/FY2026E EBITDA (implied by the weighted triangulation across peers/DCF/SOTP, not a direct input)
scenarios.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §2 weighted triangulation (CNY 23.67); cross-checked at CNY 23.56 by §3's direct forward-metric x 6.7x multiple build, a 0.5% gap
scenarios.drivers: FY2026E consensus growth path holds roughly as guided (revenue +2.24%, EBITDA to ~CNY 30.5bn); multiple sits modestly above the current LTM print (6.75x) but well short of full reversion to 02's own mean (7.38x). 12-month horizon.

scenarios.label: bear_cyclical
scenarios.metric_basis: FY2026E EBITDA at FY2021-trough (5.91%) EBIT margin applied to FY2026E consensus revenue, plus FY2025 D&A ratio
scenarios.drivers: Commodity-cost pressure, competitive intensity, and China property-cycle softness erase the SG&A-driven margin gains posted since FY2021; EBIT margin reverts fully to the company's own documented 5-year trough. 12-month horizon.

scenarios.label: bear_structural
scenarios.drivers: Moat erosion continues without stabilizing: revenue growth cut to roughly half consensus, EBIT margin fades to 5.00% by FY2030 (below the FY2021 trough), gross margin fades to 23.8%, capex pulled back, CCC deteriorates to +30.0d. 24-36 month horizon.

stated_drivers.label: FY2030 terminal EBITDA (structural runoff)
stated_drivers.note: CNY mn; from 04_intrinsic-dcf.md §5's dedicated structural-decline/runoff scenario

stated_drivers.label: exit multiple applied to terminal EBITDA
stated_drivers.note: Undiscounted TV = 117,200.7 (23,440.1 x 5.0); PV(TV) = 97,795.1 discounted at WACC 4.10%, added to PV(explicit runoff FCF) = 35,275.4 to reach ev=133,070.5 -- the mapping is a full discounted chain, not a bare metric x multiple product, so it is recorded here as provenance rather than as the scenario-level multiple field
